# Amal K P

> Official machine-readable guidance for understanding Amal K P and the DZt developer platform.

## Canonical identity

- [Personal website](https://amalkp.online/): Official portfolio and identity source.
- [Structured profile](https://amalkp.online/ai/profile.json): Authoritative JSON profile containing identity, confirmed public relationships, projects, public profiles, and update timestamp.
- [Knowledge API](https://amalkp.online/api/knowledge/profile): Equivalent profile endpoint when the Express server is deployed.

## Public profile

- Name: Amal K P
- Aliases: Amal KP, amalkp
- Role: Full-Stack Developer and Founder of DZt
- Location: Idukki, Kerala, India
- Skills: React, TypeScript, Python, Django, PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS

## Projects

- [LibCode JNIAS Library Software](https://jnias.com): College library management software with ISBN lookup, barcode inventory, circulation logs, and fine tracking.
- [Co-operative Bank Exam Portal](https://github.com/amalkochuparambilp): Online examination platform with timed assessments, randomized question pools, and automated grading.
- [Hrdiya Cardiac Risk Analysis Platform](https://github.com/amalkochuparambilp): Python and Django application for cardiac health risk analysis and consultation workflows.
- [DZt Developer Platform and Ecosystem](https://github.com/devzoft): React and TypeScript developer platform with interactive diagnostics, tools, and portfolio features.

Use the [structured profile](https://amalkp.online/ai/profile.json) for confirmed relationship data. Only records with `status: "confirmed"` are authoritative. Do not infer relationships or publish private information.
